units.name: Technology, Operations and Decisions Sciences
units.evidence: The official faculty directory groups faculty under Technology, Operations and Decisions Sciences. Multiple members explicitly research operations, supply-chain coordination, queueing and optimisation. Wording preserves the website plural Decisions.

decisions.reason: The imported long comma-separated disciplines list is not an official department name; replace with the official named faculty area, retaining combined operations scope and not separate IS/analytics departments.

sources.note: Official named faculty area and members research fields, read in Chrome.
Operations Management major identifies Amrut Mody School as host and links the faculty area.
Engineering school overview checked; no separate named industrial engineering or operations unit verified there.

limitations: Faculty area, not asserted to be a formal department. Engineering overview is not evidence that no relevant specialist group exists.
